observed_values.qualitative_value: OpenAI's public status record spans approximately 14:43–16:55 UTC and lists 15 ChatGPT components and four Codex components. Anthropic reported a roughly three-hour partial outage with service restored at 16:16 UTC. xAI status records show a Grok models outage beginning at 13:30 UTC and lasting roughly three and a half hours across multiple surfaces.

dimensions.assessment_basis: The preserved sources establish the bounded consequence described in the Incident summary: On 3 September 2026, ChatGPT/Codex, Claude and Grok experienced overlapping service-availability incidents. OpenAI reported elevated errors across ChatGPT and Codex and separately attributed its disruption to a routing error. Anthropic reported a partial Claude outage caused by an infrastructure issue, affecting Claude.ai, Claude Code, Claude Cowork and the Claude API. xAI reported a Grok models outage across multiple surfaces and later attributed its disruption to an outage at its Memphis compute centre. The temporal overlap is material ecosystem evidence, but no reviewed source establishes that the three providers shared one technical cause. Unreported downstream consequences were not inferred. Threshold applied: Material disruption of an important service or organisational workflow; a critical or important function unavailable for more than two hours; complete relevant cloud-service unavailability over 30 minutes; or limited availability affecting over five percent or one million EU users, whichever is smaller, for over one hour, with bounded recovery.
The preserved Incident evidence does not report a bandable materialised reputation and dignity impact; absence of reporting is not evidence of no harm.

The preserved Incident evidence does not report a bandable materialised environmental impact; absence of reporting is not evidence of no harm.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: OpenAI reported resolution of its ChatGPT/Codex incident. Reporting also records recovery of Claude and Grok. These restorations demonstrate repair of the affected services. The result covers the reported recoveries, not future resilience or a shared technical cause.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The providers’ reported recovery from unwanted service outages directly identifies repair mechanisms for these AI services.
